subject.title: Modular Dashboard: agent-composable Control UI workspaces (tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this modular dashboard workspace as a bundled Control UI/plugin feature, narrow it to reusable plugin/API seams, or redirect it outside core?
rationale: The current code has a plugin-tab seam, but the requested work adds a large bundled UI/product surface plus an agent-authored widget security boundary; automation cannot choose that product boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Review the stack as a bundled feature
options.body: Review and decide the linked PRs base-first, with explicit security and upgrade scrutiny before accepting any bundled default behavior.

options.title: Narrow to extension seams
options.body: Ask for only the generic plugin/API pieces that third-party dashboards need, leaving the full workspace implementation outside core for now.

options.title: Redirect to ClawHub or an external plugin
options.body: Close or pause the core tracker if maintainers decide this is optional dashboard product work that should be distributed outside the OpenClaw source tree.

recommendation.title: Review the stack as a bundled feature
recommendation.body: Review and decide the linked PRs base-first, with explicit security and upgrade scrutiny before accepting any bundled default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current plugin-tab seam and is the strongest current-main routing signal for this Control UI/plugin boundary decision.
